description: Within about 15 minutes of each other, two related stories popped up on my phone today. In the first was a story about the recent Trump Administration announcement that all grants from the U.S. Government must be approved by a political appointee, presumably to ensure that the grants meet any political party line requirements, rather than be evaluated against any sort of scientific standard.
